articles.title: Toyobo's (TSE:3101) Free Cash Turnaround: Efficiency Play or Cyclical Lift in Industrial Films?
articles.summary: Toyobo recently reported that group-level growth was led by strong demand in its Industrial Films business, especially MLCC mold-release films, while consolidation in the Airbag Fabrics segment supported efficiency gains across previously weaker operations. The company also reached an inflection point in free cash flow, with operating cash flow strength and normalized capital expenditures underpinning a healthier cash profile.
